i.norm: Verifies that calling replace(String, int, int) with a null source string does not alter the default escape character ('$') on an interpolator instance. The two offset arguments are both 807, meaning the requested substring range is empty; the call should return without performing any substitution.
Replacing on a null source with identical start/end offsets is a no-op
The default escape character must still be '$' after the no-op call
